documentation.content:
The MCP server's public metadata endpoint (https://dev.financial-portfolios.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) stopped answering 2xx. Connectors cannot sign in or call tools while this is failing.

Check: Cloud Run service financial-portfolios-ai-mcp (dev), its latest revision's logs, and whether the portal load balancer still routes /mcp and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource to it.
